name: Very ___ Time
blurb: One place word, one everyday ritual and one deadpan line become a 15 second vertical video in five shots.
default_line: You met me at a very {place_word} time in my life.

beats.camera_text: slow push-in triggered by the action
beats.direction: macro detail shot of the ritual
beats.image_prompt: Macro close-up of {ritual}, the everyday ritual of a very {place_word} time, hands and objects only, the cuff of {garment} just visible at the edge of frame, real textures, vertical 9:16
beats.motion_prompt: One small action of {ritual}: the hands move once, cause then effect, the objects settle
beats.sfx: close foley of {ritual}: a small clink, a pour or a rustle, intimate and dry

beats.direction: medium shot of the character doing the ritual
beats.image_prompt: Medium shot of the host in the middle of {ritual}, wearing {garment}, the chest embroidery reading "{chest_text}" sharp, legible and not covered by arms or hands, calm deadpan face, vertical 9:16
beats.motion_prompt: The host carries on with {ritual} calmly, one unhurried gesture, the chest text stays in view
beats.sfx: quiet room tone with one soft sound of {ritual}

beats.direction: insert of a second detail or a small reaction
beats.image_prompt: Insert shot: a second small detail of {ritual} or a quiet reaction nearby (steam, a cat, a neighbour's hands), the sleeve of {garment} in frame, vertical 9:16
beats.motion_prompt: A tiny reaction: steam drifts, a cat blinks or a hand pauses, nothing else moves
beats.sfx: one tiny diegetic sound: steam hiss, a cat purr or a spoon on glass

beats.direction: wide shot of the everyday place, character small in frame
beats.image_prompt: Wide shot of the ordinary everyday place where {ritual} happens, not a landmark, the host small in frame wearing {garment}, deadpan, vertical 9:16
beats.motion_prompt: The place breathes: light flickers or a passer-by crosses far behind, the host stays still and small in frame
beats.sfx: street and room ambience of an ordinary everyday place, distant and calm

beats.image_prompt: Close-up of the host looking straight into the camera, deadpan, wearing {garment} with the chest embroidery reading "{chest_text}" legible at the bottom of frame, vertical 9:16
beats.motion_prompt: The host looks into the camera and says the line flat and quiet, then holds the stare for one second of silence
beats.sfx: near silence, faint room tone, no music

style: vertical 9:16 composition, same host in every shot, affectionate everyday detail, deadpan tone
continuity: same garment ({garment}) with the chest text '{chest_text}' legible and unchanged

brand.garment: an oversized oxblood (#4A0E17) button-up shirt with ivory serif embroidery on the chest

host: a calm middle-aged host with a deadpan stare and quiet authority

console.name: Console cutscene
console.style: early-2000s PlayStation 2 era console game cutscene still, realistic proportions, slightly low-poly faces, baked flat lighting, slightly soft low-resolution textures, faint aliasing on edges, gentle bloom, 4:3-era game camera

flash.name: Flash lookbook
flash.style: fashion lookbook photo, direct on-camera flash, grey seamless paper background, hard shadow on the wall, 35 mm film colour, fine grain, deadpan pose

atelier.name: Atelier film
atelier.style: atelier film still, soft window light, warm film stock, shallow depth of field, quiet room
